title: Unhinged Paws
description: A new command to summon UNHINGED Wolves.
body:
This is a cursed mod that adds a new command.
"/wolfontame".

_When executing the command,_ you will summon a GLITCHED Wolf. Tame this wolf, then you can dye it blue or light blue, or you could leave it as red. Each dye has its abilites.


<details>
<summary>The Abilities (Spoiler)</summary>

## Red

Red will bring wolf summons to attack an enemy.

## Blue

Blue will dash and slash an enemy.

## Light Blue

Light Blue will strike an enemy with lightning every half-second.

</details>
